Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.logging

Class LoggingConfiguration

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.logging.LoggingConfiguration
@ConfigurationProperties(prefix="brobot.logging") public class LoggingConfiguration extends Object
Configuration for the Brobot logging system.

Provides configuration for output formats, performance optimizations, and data enrichment. Logging levels should be controlled via standard Spring Boot properties: 

 # Standard Spring Boot logging configuration
 logging.level.root=INFO
 logging.level.io.github.jspinak.brobot=DEBUG

 # Brobot-specific configuration
 brobot.logging.output.format=STRUCTURED
 brobot.logging.performance.async=true

  • Method Details

    • isLoggingEnabled

      public boolean isLoggingEnabled(LogCategory category, LogLevel level)
      Check if logging is enabled - delegates to SLF4J/Logback. This method is kept for backward compatibility but always returns true, letting the underlying logging framework handle level filtering.
      Parameters:
      category - The log category (unused)
      level - The log level to check (unused)
      Returns:
      always true - actual filtering is done by SLF4J/Logback

    • applyPreset

      public void applyPreset(LoggingConfiguration.LoggingPreset preset)
      Apply a preset configuration for output format and performance. Note: Logging levels should be set via logging.level.* properties.
      Parameters:
      preset - The preset to apply
